title: Evaluate MCP connectors and remote A2A collaboration
description: MCP would expose additional tools/resources. A2A would be evaluated for remote independent agent collaboration when that need exists. ACP remains the initial client-to-worker boundary. Do not treat these protocols as interchangeable or add all three simply for completeness.
why: Broader protocols should solve a demonstrated interoperability problem.

acceptance.text: An unmet use case identifies the required protocol
Compatibility, ownership and auth are documented before adoption
